_schema_notes.authority: Every value in this file is either supplied directly by the product owner or is null. Null means UNKNOWN, never 'default' and never 'to be inferred'.
_schema_notes.no_inference: Meanings, relationships, programme ownership, approved usage and creative symbolism must never be inferred. Only the product owner may supply them.
_schema_notes.status_semantics: status governs approval of the TERM AND ITS SPELLING, not its meaning. A term may be status='approved' while meaning is null: the string is authoritative and printable, its meaning is unknown. See D-16.
_schema_notes.exact_spelling_is_authoritative: exact_spelling is the sole authority for the canonical-string assertion in validation (spec 15.5). The capitalisation field is a human-readable description of that string, never a substitute for it.
_schema_notes.name_is_not_mark: canonical_brand_name is a TEXT STRING and may be typeset in original compositions. brand_mark_assets are FILES and are the only permitted source of official logo usage. These are different things and must never be substituted for one another. See D-17.
_schema_notes.identity_is_context_not_recipe: identity_observations describes the existing identity for creative context only. It is NOT a specification for reconstructing, tracing, redrawing or approximating the official brand mark, and must never be used as one.

identity.canonical_brand_name_usage: May be typeset as exact text in original typographic merchandise compositions. Doing so does not constitute official logo usage.
identity.brand_mark_assets_status: NOT SUPPLIED. No authoritative production logo files have been provided. Screenshots are not authoritative assets.
identity.brand_mark_reconstruction: PROHIBITED. The official logo/wordmark must never be reconstructed, traced, redrawn, approximated or generated from screenshots or from any description in this file.

identity_observations._purpose: Creative context only. Not a reconstruction specification. See _schema_notes.identity_is_context_not_recipe.
observations: THE / INCREDIBLE as a dominant typographic structure
YOU as a major visual element
red as an important existing brand colour
a human figure integrated into the identity

colours.name: brand red
colours.hex_status: UNKNOWN. Must be supplied by the product owner from authoritative brand assets. Must not be sampled, estimated or eyedropped from screenshots.

usage_tiers.description: Reproduction of the official brand mark.
usage_tiers.requires: A supplied authoritative logo asset file.
usage_tiers.generation_rule: Asset is PLACED, never generated, traced or approximated. See D-17.

usage_tiers.description: Original merchandise composition that belongs recognisably to the brand.
usage_tiers.requires: Nothing beyond approved vocabulary and creative territory.
usage_tiers.generation_rule: May typeset canonical_brand_name and approved vocabulary as exact text via deterministic typography. Must not reproduce or approximate the official mark.

usage_tiers.description: Merchandise for a specific programme or campaign.
usage_tiers.requires: Approved vocabulary for the relevant programme.
usage_tiers.generation_rule: As brand_inspired. Programme association must come from Brand DNA, never inferred.

usage_tiers.description: New creative treatment belonging to The Incredible You universe without reproducing brand marks or necessarily using the brand name.

creative_territory._note: Reference images supplied by the product owner are inspiration for composition and style diversity ONLY. No supplied artwork may be reproduced, traced, imitated or derived from.
creative_territory.output_character: clean standalone artwork suitable for transfer printing

vocabulary.capitalisation: Two words. Initial capital on 'Inner'; 'DNA' fully uppercase.
Hyphenated. Uppercase 'N', hyphen, initial capital 'C', lowercase 'odes'.
Hyphenated. Uppercase 'E', hyphen, initial capital 'C', lowercase 'odes'.
Two words. Initial capital on both.
Three words. Initial capital on each.

ingestion.rule: Extraction must never automatically convert discovered terminology into approved Brand DNA. Extracted entries enter this file with status='candidate' and a populated source_ref, and remain unusable until the product owner sets status='approved'.
ingestion.schema_readiness: The status and source_ref fields exist from schema_version 1 specifically so that adding ingestion later is a filter, not a migration.
